name: Go + Gin + sqlc + PostgreSQL + Redis
note: Requires the Go toolchain. No database server is needed: the suite uses the stdlib test harness. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Module builds with no errors
eval_tasks.instruction: The Go module must compile cleanly from a clean checkout.

eval_tasks.title: go vet reports no suspicious constructs
eval_tasks.instruction: Static analysis must find no vet diagnostics.

eval_tasks.title: Test suite passes
eval_tasks.instruction: The handler and routing test suite must pass.

eval_tasks.title: No data races under concurrent load
eval_tasks.instruction: The race detector must find no races; these handlers run concurrently per request.
